description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Industrial Dispute - Mrs. S. P. M. Martheenu and Land Reform Commission
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically an order appointing an arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and amendments, and contains a formal legal order issued under statutory authority. While it mentions government officials (Minister of Labour), the core content is about legal procedures and regulatory implementation rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
